topics.title: Fiction aur non-fiction
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
Kya aap ne kabhi socha hai ke aik kahani aur aik maqala (article) mein kya farq hota hai? Agar hum sabzi mandi jayein aur wahan aik kahani sunaayein ya phir sabziyon ke faidein par aik maqala padhein, tou aap ko kaise pata chalega ke yeh fiction hai ya non-fiction?

## SAMJHAO
Fiction aur non-fiction do tarah ki writing hoti hain. Fiction wo hoti hai jo asal mein nahi hoti, yani iska taluq haqeeqat se nahi hota. Ismein kahaniyan hoti hain, jahan humare pas superheroes, jadoo, aur anokhi duniya hoti hai. Jaise ke "Ali Baba aur Chalis Chor", yeh fiction hai!

Aik aur taraf, non-fiction wo hoti hai jo haqiqatan par mabni hoti hai. Ismein aise articles ya kitaabein hoti hain jo asal mein hone wali baatein batati hain. Yeh zindagi ke asal maamlaat par hoti hain, jaise ke "Pakistan ki tareekh ya Cricket ki asal kahani." Ismein facts hote hain jo hum asal mein jaan sakte hain.

Kabhi kabhi toh yeh dono ek saath milti hain, jese ke "Aam jadoo ki kahani" mein writer ne asal facts bhi shamil kiye ho sakta hai. Magar hum hain fiction aur non-fiction ko alag karne mein maahir! 

Aksar logon ko yeh samajhna mushkil hota hai ke yeh dono term kis tarah alag hain, lekin agar aap dhyan se dekhein, tou aap asani se samajh jayenge. Kahaniyan hamesha dilchasp hoti hain, lekin haqiqatan kabhi kabhi thodi boring lag sakti hai.

## MISAAL
Socho, aap rickshaw mein baith kar bazaar ja rahe ho. Wahan ek chota sa bachcha kahani suna raha hai ke kaise usne ek jadoo ki par ronaat dekh li thi. Yeh ek fiction kahani hai. Phir agar aap "Samundar ke paani ki safai par aik maqala" padhein, tou yeh non-fiction hai, kyunki ismein asal baatein hain jo asal mein hoti hain.

## KARO
Aapko ab ek chhota sa activity karna hai. Ek khud ki kahani likhein, jise aapne suna ya dekha hai. Use fiction mein rakhein, jahan aap kuch bhi kar sakte hain! Lekin baad mein aap apne dosto ke liye aik maqala likhein, jis mein aap koi asal baat share karein. Jaise ke "Khush Rehna Kaise?" 

## SAWAAL
1. Fiction aur non-fiction mein kya farq hai?
2. Aapki pasandida fiction kahani ka naam kya hai? 
3. Kya aapne kabhi kisi non-fiction article ka samna kiya hai? Uska taluq kis topic se tha?

Best of luck, Student! 
English Ma'am

questions.explanation: Yeh kahani hai jo asal mein nahi hui.

questions.q: Non-fiction ka kya matlab hai?
questions.explanation: Yeh asal maloomat par mabni hota hai.

questions.q: Masnooi kahaniyan kis tarah ki hoti hain?
questions.explanation: Yeh buzz aur khush-mizaaj kahaniyan hoti hain.

questions.q: Agar koi maqala kisi kitab ka hissah ho, woh kaisi hai?
questions.explanation: Yeh haqeeqi maloomat ka hissa hota hai.

questions.q: Jese 'Choti si ghalti' aik kahani hai, yeh kis ki misaal hai?
questions.explanation: Yeh puraani kahaniyan ghalatiyon par mabni hoti hain.

topics.title: Grammar advanced
topics.lesson:
## HOOK  
Bachon, kabhi socha hai ke kyun hum kehte hain "Woh bahut tez daudta hai"? Ya "Maya akele mehsoos karti hai"? Kya aap samajhte hain ke ismein kya khaas hai? Aaj hum in sab cheezon ko seekhenge!

## SAMJHAO  
Adverbs woh lafz hain jo verbs, adjectives, ya doosre adverbs ko describe karte hain. Yeh humein kaise pata lagta hai ke koi kaam kis tarah ya kab ho raha hai. Jaise "Woh dosti se bolti hai" mein "dosti se" ek adverb hai jo batata hai ke bolne ka tareeqa kaisa hai.

Ab baat karte hain Prepositions ki. Yeh lafz kisi cheez ki position ya relation batate hain. Misal ke taur par: "Woh kursi ke upar baitha hai." Yahan "upertak" aik preposition hai jo batata hai ke woh ladka kahaan hai.

Conjunctions wo lafz hain jo do ya zyada ideas ya sentences ko jodte hain. Jaise "Mujhe cricket khelna pasand hai aur mujhe football bhi." Yahan "aur" ek conjunction hai jo dono pasandiyon ko ek saath jod raha hai.

Yeh teeno concepts aapas mein milke sentences ko behter banate hain. Jab aap adverbs, prepositions, aur conjunctions ka sahi istemal karte hain, aapki zubaan aur likhai dono zyada rangin aur interesting ban jaati hain.

## MISAAL  
Chalo, ab hum ek real-life example lete hain. Jab aap bazaar jate ho, toh aap keh sakte ho, "Woh bazaar mein jaldi se jaata hai." Yahaan "jaldi se" ek adverb hai, aur "mein" ek preposition hai jo batata hai ke woh kahan ja rahe hain. Ab agar aap kahen, "Mujhe biryani khana hai aur aapko bhi!" Toh yaha "aur" conjunction hai jo aapko aur aapke dost ko ek saath jodta hai. 

## KARO  
Ab aapko apne ghar ya school mein ek choti si activity karni hai. Apne ek dosto ya ghar ke kisi shakhs ke saath baat karein aur chaar sentences banayein jismein at least ek adverb, ek preposition, aur ek conjunction ho. Phir apna yeh dialogue dosto ko sunaayein. Dekhein ke kaise yeh cheezein aapas mein mil kar baat ko interesting banati hain!

## SAWAAL  
1. Adverb kya hota hai?  
2. "Kahaan" kaun si category ki word hai: Preposition ya Adverb?  
3. Conjunction ka kya kaam hai?

English Ma'am

questions.q: Adverb ka kya matlab hai?
questions.a: Koi aisa lafz jo harkat ya sifat ko bayan kare.
questions.b: Koi aisa lafz jo naam ko bayan kare.
questions.c: Koi aisa lafz jo jumlay ko mukammal kare.
questions.d: Koi aisa lafz jo sirf aisa hi rahe.
questions.explanation: Adverb ko kisi harkat ya sifat ki tafseel dene ke liye istemal kiya jata hai.

questions.q: "In" ka istemal kis liye kiya jata hai?
questions.a: Kisi cheez ke andar hone ka izhar karne ke liye.
questions.b: Kisi cheez ko kharij karne ke liye.
questions.c: Do cheezon ko mila karke bayan karne ke liye.
questions.d: Kisi wakht ka izhar karne ke liye.
questions.explanation: "In" preposition hai jo kisi cheez ke andar hone ki taraf ishara karta hai.

questions.q: "Aur" ka istemal kis cheez ke liye hota hai?
questions.b: Do ya zyada cheezon ko mila kar bayan karne ke liye.
questions.c: Kisi cheez ko khatam karne ke liye.
questions.d: Ek cheez ke khilaf dusri cheez ka bayan karne ke liye.
questions.explanation: "Aur" conjunction hai jo do ya zyada cheezon ko mila kar bayan karta hai.

questions.q: "Quickly" kis ka mishal hai?
questions.explanation: "Quickly" ek adverb hai jo harkat ki tareeqe ko bayan karta hai.

questions.q: "Before" ka istemal kis liye hota hai?
questions.a: Mawaqit ko bayan karne ke liye.
questions.b: Kisi cheez ko kharij karne ke liye.
questions.c: Kisi cheez ko samjhne ke liye.
questions.d: Kisi cheez ko naye se shuru karne ke liye.
questions.explanation: "Before" preposition hai jo waqt ke izhar ke liye istemal hota hai.

topics.title: Articles a an the
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
A apple galat — an apple theek. Chhote se article se sentence smart lagta hai!

## SAMJHAO
Articles: a, an, the.
- a + consonant sound (a book, a university — /y/ sound)
- an + vowel sound (an apple, an hour — silent h)
- the = specific wali cheez (the sun, the book on the table)

## MISAAL
Islamabad mein the Faisal Mosque — specific. A park — koi sa park.

## KARO
5 cheezein likho: a/an/the choose karo.

## SAWAAL
1. Apple se pehle?
2. The kab?
3. University se pehle a ya an?

questions.q: ___ apple
questions.explanation: Apple vowel sound — an.

questions.q: ___ book on my desk (specific)
questions.explanation: Specific book — the.

questions.q: ___ university (starts with /y/)
questions.explanation: Consonant sound /y/ — a.

questions.q: ___ hour (silent h)
questions.explanation: Vowel sound — an.

questions.q: Articles kaam kya karte hain?
questions.explanation: Articles nouns ko clear karte hain.

topics.title: Tenses: Present Past Future
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
Bachon, socho agar tumhari maa kehti hai ke “tum kal school nahi gaye.” Tumhe kaisa lagta hai? Ya agar woh kehti hai “aaj tum kya khanay wale ho?” Yeh sab alag alag waqt ki baatein hain. Aaj hum in waqt ki baaton ko samjhenge!

## SAMJHAO
Tense kiya hai? Tense woh hota hai jo humein batata hai ke koi kaam kis waqt (time) hua hai. Chalo, pehle present tense se shuru karte hain. Present tense ka matlab hai ke koi kaam abhi ho raha hai ya barabar hota hai. Jaise ke “Main school jaata hoon” ya “Mey cricket khel raha hoon”.

Ab baat karte hain past tense ki. Past tense ka matlab hai ke koi kaam pehle hua hai. Jaise ke “Main kal school gaya”. Yahan humne bataya ke kaam ab khatam ho gaya hai aur woh kal hua.

Ab last hain future tense. Future tense ka matlab hai ke koi kaam baad mein hoga. Jaise ke “Main kal school jaaoonga” ya “Main aaj subha biryani khane jaaoonga”. 

In tenses ke andar do types hote hain: Simple aur Continuous. Simple tense bilkul seedha hota hai, jabke Continuous tense se ye pata chalta hai ke kaam ek process mein hai. Jaise ke “Main school jaa raha hoon” (Continuous) aur “Main school jaata hoon” (Simple).

## MISAAL
Chalo ek bazaar ka example lete hain. Aaj tumne bazaar jana hai. Tum kehte ho “Main bazaar jaata hoon” (Simple Present) jo tumhara routine hai. Agar tumne kal bazaar gaya to kehte ho “Main kal bazaar gaya” (Simple Past) aur agar tum soch rahe ho ke kal tum bazaar jaoge, to kehte ho “Main kal bazaar jaaoonga” (Simple Future). 

Agar tum bazaar mein kuch khareed rahe ho, to kehte ho “Main khareed raha hoon” (Continuous Present). Aur agar tum kal bazaar mein kharid rahe the, to kehte ho “Main kal kharid raha tha” (Continuous Past).

## KARO
Bachon, ab ghar par yeh activity karo. Apne din ka plan banao. Likho ke aaj tum kya kar rahe ho, kal kya kiya aur kal kya karne wale ho. Is tarah tum present, past aur future tense ka istemal karke practice karoge. Apne dost ya parivaar ke saath share karo!

## SAWAAL
1. Present tense ka kya matlab hai? Ek misaal do.
2. Past tense ki ek kahani sunao.
3. Future tense ki ek soch bana ke sunaao.

Tumhara dosto ka sath hona zaroori hai. English seekhne mein maza aayega! 

Sign off: English Ma'am.

topics.title: Vocabulary building
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
Aaj hum ek aise khilone ke baare mein baat karenge jo hamesha alag-alag rangon aur size mein hote hain. Kya kabhi aapne socha hai ke in khilone kaise banaye jaate hain? Prefixes aur suffixes ki wajah se! Chalo, is mazeedaar safar pe chalain!

## SAMJHAO
Prefixes wo shabd hain jo kisi shabd ke agay lagaye jaate hain. Jaise ke "un" jo kisi cheez ko ulat deta hai. Agar hum "happy" (khush) shabd ko lein toh jab hum ismein "un" lagate hain, toh yeh ban jaata hai "unhappy" (khush nahi).

Suffixes wo hote hain jo kisi shabd ke peeche lagaye jaate hain. Jaise "ful" jo kisi cheez ko bhara hua dikhata hai. "Beauty" (khubsurti) ke saath jab hum "ful" lagate hain, toh yeh ban jaata hai "beautiful" (khubsurat).

Compound words do alag alag shabdon ko mila kar ek naya shabd banate hain. Jaise "tooth" (daant) aur "brush" (bruk) ko mila kar "toothbrush" banate hain. Yeh shabdwer ek naya maayne rakhte hain jo dono ki zarurat ko poora karte hain.

Yeh sabh chizen humein vocabulary build karne mein madad deti hain, taake hum apne khayalat aur jazbat ko behtar tareeqe se bayaan kar sakein.

## MISAAL
Chalo ab thodi si baat karte hain bazaar ki. Jab aap bazaar jaate hain, toh aapko "biryani" ka khayal aata hai. Is "biryani" ke badle agar aap "unbiryani" ke liye sochain, toh iska matlab hai ke aap bina biryani ke samay guzar rahe hain! Hum dekhte hain ke kis tarah ek aisi "biryani" jo humari khushi ka sabab ban sakti hai, par "unbiryani" hamesha humay udas kar sakti hai.

## KARO
Ab aap yeh activity karein! Ghar par ya school mein, kuch shabd lein aur unhein prefixes aur suffixes ke saath mila kar nayi shabd banayein. Jaise "do" (karna) ko le kar "redo" (dobara karna) bana sakte hain. Ya phir "play" (khelna) ko le kar "playful" (khelne wale) bana sakte hain. Yeh activity aapke doston ke saath bhi karke dekh sakte hain!

## SAWAAL
1. Prefix aur suffix mein kya farq hota hai?
2. Compound words kya hote hain? Ek misaal do.
3. Agar aap "happy" ke saath "un" lagate hain toh kya banega?

Aapki English Ma'am

questions.q: Niche diye gaye lafz mein se kaunsa lafz 'unhappy' ka sahih prefix hai?
questions.explanation: 'Un' prefix hai jo isi lafz ke sath 'happy' ko 'unhappy' banata hai.

questions.q: Kaunsa suffix lafz 'beauty' ko 'beautiful' banata hai?
questions.explanation: 'Ful' suffix lagane se 'beauty' ka matlab 'khubsurti' ho jata hai.

questions.q: Kaun sa compound lafz 'rain' aur 'bow' se mil kar banta hai?
questions.explanation: 'Rainbow' lafz mein 'rain' aur 'bow' mila kar bana hai.

questions.q: Niche diye gaye lafz mein se kaunsa lafz 'rebuild' ka sahih prefix hai?
questions.explanation: 'Re' prefix ka matlab hai phir se kisi cheez ko karna, isliye 'rebuild'.

questions.q: Kaunsa lafz 'friend' aur 'ship' se mil kar banta hai?
questions.explanation: 'Friendship' lafz 'friend' aur 'ship' ke jor se bana hai, jo dosti ke taluq ko darshata hai.

topics.title: Essay aur diary
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
Kya aap ne kabhi apne khayalat ko likhne ki koshish ki hai? Agar aap din bhar ki mizaaj ya kisi khaas lamhe ko qalam karein, toh kya wo aap ke liye yaadgaar nahi hoga? Chalo, aaj hum essay aur diary entries ke bare mein sikhte hain!

## SAMJHAO
Essay aur diary alag-alag cheezein hain. Essay wo hota hai jismein aap kisi topic par apne khayalat ko vyakt karte hain. Ismein aapko sochna parta hai aur apne ideas ko achhe tareeqe se pesh karna hota hai. Mazid aap apne points ko tarteeb se likhte hain taake reader asaani se samajh sake.

Diary writing thodi personal hoti hai. Ismein aap apne din ke baare mein, jazbat aur soch ko likhte hain. Jaise aap apne doston ke sath guzarne wale waqt ya phir kisi khaas waqiya ke baare mein likhte hain. Yeh ek tarah ka personal journal hota hai.

Essay mein aapko introduction, body, aur conclusion include karna hota hai. Wahi diary entry sirf ek related date ke sath aati hai aur aap apne jazbat ko likhte hain. Dono cheezein writing ke liye important hain, lekin unki tareeqe alag hain.

Ab hum yeh samajhte hain ke aap ek achha essay ya diary entry kaise likh sakte hain! Yeh aap ki writing skills ko behter banata hai aur aapke ideas ko vyakt karne ka mauka deta hai.

## MISAAL
Chalo, sochte hain ke aapne bazaar jana hai. Aap kisi din bazaar gaye hain aur wahaan apne saathiyon ke sath mazay kiya. Aap is waqiya ke baare mein ek essay likh sakte hain. Jaise shuruat karte hain "Mujhe bazaar jana bohot pasand hai kyunki wahaan bahut saari cheezein milti hain...." Phir aap body mein khaas cheezein batate hain jo aap ne dekhi, jaise biryani ki khushboo ya chaat ki khushi.

Agar aap diary entry likhna chahte hain, toh aap likh sakte hain "Aaj maine bazaar gaya tha aur meri dost ke sath waqt guzara. Wahan mujhe biryani khane ka bohot maza aaya..." Is tarah, aap apne jazbat aur khayalat ko izhar kar sakte hain.

## KARO
Aapko essay aur diary entry likhne ki practice karni hai. Ghar par, apne din ke kisi khaas lamhe ko chuniye. Pehle apna essay likhiye, jismein aap us din ki chizain aur jazbat bayaan karen. Phir, usi din ki diary entry likhiye, lekin zyada personal tone mein. Dekhiye kya aap dono par alag tareeqon se apni soch ko vyakt kar paate hain!

## SAWAAL
1. Essay aur diary entry mein kya farq hai?
2. Kya aapne kabhi apne din ki diary entry likhi hai? Usmein aapne kya likha tha?
3. Essay likhte waqt aapko kya cheezein yaad rakhni chahiye?

Khuda Hafiz,  
English Ma'am

questions.a: Aj ke din kya kiya aur kya mehsoos kiya

topics.title: Formal letter
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
Kya aap kabhi kisi dost ko special invitation bhejne ka sochte hain? Ya phir kisi school function ke liye letter likhne ki zaroorat mehsoos ki hai? Aaj hum seekhenge ke formal aur informal letters kaise likhte hain!

## SAMJHAO
Sab se pehle, letters do tarah ke hote hain: formal aur informal. Informal letters woh hote hain jo hum apne doston ya ghar walon ko likhte hain. Yeh zyada relaxed hote hain aur isme hum aapas mein baatein karte hain jaise keh rahe hain ke "Kese ho? Aaj kal kya chal raha hai?"

Dusri taraf, formal letters woh hote hain jo hum kisi chhoti ya badi institution ko bhejte hain, jese school, government office ya kisi business ko. Isme humay zyada respect show karna hota hai aur thodi formal language istemal karni hoti hai.

Formal letter likhne ka ek format hota hai. Sab se pehle aapko apna address top left corner mein likhna hota hai. Uske baad date likhte hain, phir jisse aap letter likh rahe hain uska naam aur address. Phir greeting hoti hai, like “Dear Sir/Madam,” aur uske baad body mein apni baat rakhte hain. Last mein, aap “Sincerely” ya “Yours faithfully” likhte hain, aur apna naam sign karte hain.

Hum informal letter mein yeh sab nahi likhte. Hum sirf greeting se shuru karte hain, jese “Dear Ali,” aur phir apni baatein share karte hain. Last mein, hum “Take care” ya “Love” likhte hain, aur apna naam sign karte hain. 

## MISAAL
Chalo ab ek misaal lete hain. Suppose, aapke dost ne aapse birthday party bulai hai. Aap us ko ek informal letter likhte hain. Aap likhte hain: "Dear Ahmed, maine suna tumhari party bohot mazedaar hogi! Mujhe zaroor ana hai. Aakar hum cricket khelte hain, aur biryani khate hain!"

Ab agar aap school principal ko ek request letter likhte hain ke aapko school ki trip par jana hai, toh aap formal letter ka istemal karte hain. Aap keh sakte hain: "Dear Principal, mujhe aap se yeh request hai ke mujhe school trip mein jaane ki permission di jaye. Main is safar ke liye tayyar hoon. Thank you."

## KARO
Ab aap ghar par ya school mein ek activity kar sakte hain. Ek informal letter apne kisi dost ko likhein jisme aap unse unki summer vacation ke baare mein poochte hain. Aur phir ek formal letter likhein jisme aap principal se puche ki kya aap school trip par ja sakte hain. Yeh dono letters aap apne school mein ya ghar par practice kar sakte hain.

## SAWAAL
1. Formal letter ka kya format hota hai?
2. Informal letter kis liye likha jata hai?
3. Aapko formal letter likhte waqt kya cheezein yaad rakhni chahiye?

Best of luck with your letters!  
English Ma'am

questions.a: Kisi formal maamle par rabta karna
questions.explanation: Kyun sahi hai: Formal letter ka maqsad rasmi maamlat par rabta karna hota hai.

questions.a: Dosti ya family ke liye likha jata hai
questions.explanation: Kyun sahi hai: Informal letter doston aur family members ke liye hota hai.

questions.q: Formal letter ki shuruaat kaise ki jati hai?
questions.explanation: Kyun sahi hai: Formal letter ki shuruaat hamesha 'Dear Sir/Madam' se hoti hai.

questions.q: Formal letter ka ending kaisa hota hai?
questions.explanation: Kyun sahi hai: Formal letters ki ending 'Yours sincerely' se ki jati hai.

questions.q: Informal letter likhte waqt kis cheez ka khayal rakhna chahiye?
questions.explanation: Kyun sahi hai: Informal letters mein personal tone ka istemal karna chahiye.
